Management Plan

- Assessment: Likely viral illness per clinician; expected course ~7–10 days.
- Symptomatic care: Rest, maintain hydration, and use acetaminophen (paracetamol) as needed.
- Work: Advised to take 1–2 days off for rest; reassess ability to work early next week.
- Safety net: Return if not improving in 2–3 days; seek earlier review if breathing worsens or if persistent fever and cough, at which point antibiotics may be considered.
- Chronic conditions: Continue metformin and lisinopril as prescribed; continue routine follow-up with usual doctor.
- Alcohol counseling: Advised reduction due to hypertension and diabetes—suggested trial of cutting down to two glasses per week, then one per week, with goal of cessation if tolerable.
